description:
As an OrangeHRM user
  I want the login screen to accept only valid credentials
  So that employee data stays protected

elements.name: Sign in is rejected for invalidPassword

steps.name: I am on the OrangeHRM login page
I sign in as "invalidPassword"
I should see the login alert "Invalid credentials"
I should stay on the login page

elements.name: Sign in is rejected for unknownUser

steps.name: I am on the OrangeHRM login page
I sign in as "unknownUser"
I should see the login alert "Invalid credentials"
I should stay on the login page

elements.name: An administrator signs in successfully

steps.name: I am on the OrangeHRM login page
I sign in as "admin"
I should land on the dashboard
the top bar should show the logged in user

elements.name: Submitting an empty form shows field level validation

steps.name: I am on the OrangeHRM login page
I sign in as "emptyCredentials"
both credential fields should be flagged as required
I should stay on the login page

elements.name: Signing out returns the user to the login page

steps.name: I am on the OrangeHRM login page
I sign in as "admin"
I sign out
I should stay on the login page

elements.name: The session is invalidated after signing out

steps.name: I am on the OrangeHRM login page
I sign in as "admin"
I sign out
I open the employee list URL directly
I should stay on the login page

elements.name: The login page presents the branding and hides what is typed as a password

steps.name: I am on the OrangeHRM login page
the page should be titled "OrangeHRM"
the login branding should be visible
the password field should hide what is typed into it

elements.name: The password reset page is reachable from the login page

steps.name: I am on the OrangeHRM login page
I follow the forgotten password link
I should be taken to the password reset page

elements.name: Signing in without a password is rejected before the request is sent

steps.name: I am on the OrangeHRM login page
I sign in as "missingPassword"
only the password field should be flagged as required
I should stay on the login page

name: Authentication

description:
As a signed in user
  I want the dashboard to load and the navigation to work
  So that I can reach the modules my role allows

elements.name: The dashboard presents its widgets

steps.name: I am signed in as "admin"
the dashboard should show at least 3 widgets
the widgets should include "Quick Launch"

elements.name: Every module an administrator can see opens its own screen

steps.name: I am signed in as "admin"
each of these modules should open from the side menu

name: Dashboard

description:
As an integrator
  I want the employee endpoints to behave predictably
  So that anything built on them can be trusted

elements.name: The whole employee lifecycle through the API alone

steps.name: I am signed in as "admin"
I create an employee through the API
the API should return the same employee record
I update the personal details of that employee through the API
the API should return the updated personal details
I delete the employee through the API
the API should no longer return the employee

elements.name: Creating an employee without firstName is rejected

steps.name: I am signed in as "admin"
I try to create an employee without a "firstName"
the API should reject it with status 422

elements.name: Creating an employee without lastName is rejected

steps.name: I am signed in as "admin"
I try to create an employee without a "lastName"
the API should reject it with status 422

elements.name: The employee list endpoint paginates

steps.name: I am signed in as "admin"
I create 3 employees through the API
I ask the API for the first 2 of them
it should report a total of 3 and return 2 of them
the second page should hold the remaining one, with no overlap

name: Employee API

description:
As an HR administrator
  I want to create, update and remove an employee
  So that the workforce records stay accurate

  Every scenario cleans up after itself: whatever the scenario created is deleted
  through the API in the After hook, even when the scenario fails part way.

elements.name: Full lifecycle of an employee, verified through the UI and the API

steps.name: I am signed in as "admin"
I create a new employee through the PIM module
the employee should be saved and opened on the personal details screen
the API should return the same employee record
I update the personal details of the employee
the update should be confirmed on screen
the API should return the updated personal details
I delete the employee from the employee list
the employee should no longer be listed
the API should no longer return the employee

elements.name: Mandatory fields are enforced when adding an employee

steps.name: I am signed in as "admin"
I open the add employee screen
I save the employee form without filling it in
the first and last name fields should be flagged as required

elements.name: An employee created through the API is visible in the UI

steps.name: I am signed in as "admin"
I create an employee through the API
I search for that employee in the employee list
exactly one employee row should be listed
the listed row should show the employee id and name

elements.name: Personal details changed through the API are shown in the UI

steps.name: I am signed in as "admin"
I create an employee through the API
I update the personal details of that employee through the API
the personal details screen should show the updated values
the date of birth should be shown in the instance date format

elements.name: The employee list can be filtered by employee name

steps.name: I am signed in as "admin"
I create an employee through the API
I search for that employee by name in the employee list
exactly one employee row should be listed
the listed row should show the employee id and name

elements.name: An employee id that is already in use is rejected

steps.name: I am signed in as "admin"
I create an employee through the API
I try to create another employee with the same employee id
the API should reject it with status 422
the rejection should name "employeeId" as the invalid parameter

elements.name: Resetting the filter brings the full employee list back

steps.name: I am signed in as "admin"
I create an employee through the API
I search for that employee in the employee list
exactly one employee row should be listed
I reset the employee list filter
more than one employee row should be listed

elements.name: The record count on screen matches the API for the same filter

steps.name: I am signed in as "admin"
I create an employee through the API
I search for that employee by name in the employee list
the record count on screen should match the total the API reports for that filter

elements.name: Several employees can be removed in one bulk delete

steps.name: I am signed in as "admin"
I create 2 employees through the API
I search for those employees by their shared name prefix
I delete all the listed employees in one action
no employee rows should be listed
the API should no longer return any of them

elements.name: Contact details saved in the UI are returned by the API

steps.name: I am signed in as "admin"
I create an employee through the API
I save contact details for that employee in the UI
the API should return the same contact details

name: Employee lifecycle

description:
As an administrator
  I want the leave screens to agree with the leave API
  So that what a user picks from is what the system actually has

elements.name: The leave list opens for an administrator

steps.name: I am signed in as "admin"
I open the leave list
the leave list should offer the filters

elements.name: The leave types offered on screen are the ones the API reports

steps.name: I am signed in as "admin"
I open the leave list
the leave types in the filter should match the ones the API returns

name: Leave

description:
As a hiring administrator
  I want candidates to be created and found reliably
  So that an application is never lost between the API and the screen

elements.name: The candidate list opens with its filters

steps.name: I am signed in as "admin"
I open the candidate list
the candidate list should offer the filters

elements.name: A candidate created through the API appears in the candidate list

steps.name: I am signed in as "admin"
I create a candidate through the API
I open the candidate list
exactly one row should be listed for that candidate
the API should return the same candidate

elements.name: A candidate without an email address is rejected

steps.name: I am signed in as "admin"
I try to create a candidate without an email address
the API should reject it with status 422
the rejection should name "email" as the invalid parameter

name: Recruitment

description:
As a security conscious HR team
  I want each user role to only reach the modules it is entitled to
  So that self service users cannot administer the system

elements.name: An administrator sees every module

steps.name: I am signed in as "admin"
the side menu should contain the modules for the "Admin" role

elements.name: An ESS user cannot reach the administration modules

steps.name: I am signed in as "admin"
an employee with an "ESS" account exists
the ESS account is listed under Admin - User Management
that user signs in from a separate session
the side menu should contain the modules for the "ESS" role
the side menu should not contain the modules forbidden for the "ESS" role
the admin users API should reject the request with status 403
opening the admin page directly should be refused with status 403

elements.name: An anonymous caller cannot read employee data

steps.name: I am signed in as "admin"
an unauthenticated client calls the employees API
the API should reject it with status 401

elements.name: An ESS user can read the directory but not change it

steps.name: I am signed in as "admin"
an employee with an "ESS" account exists
that user signs in from a separate session
that session should be allowed to read the employee list
that session should be refused when it tries to create an employee
that user should be able to open My Info

name: Role based access
